approvals.note: Recorded by the Claude worker under Leif's 2026-11-10 standing rule: bug fixes that make behavior match existing requirements may run the full lifecycle with 0xLeif as actor. Scope: approve applies the send-back own-ADDED-block exception per REQ-change-123 (#1001).

approved_scope.title: Approve accepts a sent-back change's revised body for a requirement it added itself
approved_scope.description: approve accepts a sent-back change's revised body for a requirement it added itself
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-change-123 already requires that after a send-back a kept ADDED item with a new body replaces the change's earlier body; materialization did, but approve refused the revised requirement body first. This change makes approve match the existing requirement
acceptance_criteria: after a send-back, change approve accepts a revised body for an ADDED requirement whose key the send-back recorded as this change's own applied item while the canonical text is still that item's text, and materialization then replaces the block; an ADDED requirement whose canonical text someone else changed is still refused with 'cannot add existing block'

answers.constraints: change.3md lessons on send-back (#914, #960): approve and materialization must judge a sent-back change's own text the same way, through the one sent_back_added_block_is_own helper
